title: Reusable compute settings for GTSfM
subtitle: Save a setup, reload it, and see what workers actually ran.
context: GTSfM turns photos into a 3D model. Dask assigns the work to CPU/GPU workers.
before: Custom worker, memory and GPU settings lived in the current form. No named setup to reload after restart.
after: Save a profile. Reload it, validate it, launch through the existing runner, and compare requested vs. observed settings.
why: Makes experiments easier to repeat and configuration mistakes easier to spot.
finding: Manual settings and saved profiles produced byte-identical reconstruction exports.
scope: Tested on four images with one RTX 3080. Speed, accuracy and larger-scene gains remain unproven.
